description: This file defines a MarkdownRenderer class for rendering Markdown content into sanitized HTML, with support for custom tag class mappings and special handling for HTML code blocks.

classes.name: MarkdownRenderer
classes.description: A service class for rendering Markdown into sanitized HTML with customizable tag classes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Converts Markdown string to sanitized HTML, applying optional tag class mappings.

methods.name: applyTagClassMap
methods.description: Applies custom CSS classes to Markdown tokens based on provided tag-class mappings.

methods.name: unapplyTagClassMap
methods.description: Restores original token rendering rules after custom class application.
